reason: A Windows desktop launcher for DSH Web that creates a shortcut, starts or restarts the local service, and opens or refreshes the browser interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，并支持启动或重启本地服务及打开或刷新浏览器页面。
summaries.en: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut for DSH Web and supports starting or restarting the local service and opening or refreshing its browser page.

capabilities: Creates, updates, and removes a Windows desktop shortcut
Starts and restarts the local DSH Web process
Opens or refreshes browser pages for the local DSH Web interface
Writes local runtime and log files
